plan.publication_gate: The selected method and complete pilot selection evidence must match committed files on origin/main before any evaluation scoring

statistics.attacker_share_scope: Attack-present scenarios only; never average undefined all-empty rewards away
statistics.bootstrap_method: Fixed-seed percentile bootstrap of seed means with exact rational arithmetic and linear percentile interpolation; sample SD is also reported
statistics.bootstrap_unit: Complete seed, jointly across compared rules and scenarios
statistics.honest_cost_scope: Primary paired tests use attack-present conditions; also report honest-cost summaries including attack-free training
statistics.interpretation: Scenario-level tests summarize the fixed experimental conditions and do not establish independence of conditions sharing seeds or population-wide security guarantees
statistics.long_run_policy: Analyze the long runs separately; do not combine them with the main-round horizon to increase the sample count
statistics.multiple_testing: One Holm family across both primary metrics and all three baseline contrasts; missing tests remain explicitly undefined and retain their place in the family size
statistics.paired_tests: Two-sided exact conditional Wilcoxon signed-rank on every attack-present condition and seed pair; discard zero differences, use average ranks for ties
statistics.scenario_policy: One attack-free condition, one fixed five-over-thirty mixture, and the other attacks at each declared fraction; no duplicate fraction labels
statistics.seed_check: Also report the paired test on complete seed-level pooled differences; with five nonzero pairs its minimum two-sided exact p-value is 0.0625
statistics.undefined_policy: Retain undefined metrics and their counts; require all planned seeds for each reported confidence interval; do not impute an evaluation reward share

status: complete fixed-design comparison; frozen-method outcomes retained
